name: get_alerts
description: Retrieve Wazuh security alerts with optional filters by time range, severity level, agent name, or rule ID.

arguments.name: min_level
arguments.desc: Minimum Wazuh rule severity level (0-16). Default: 0

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Number of results to return. Default: 100

name: search_alerts
description: Full-text search across Wazuh alert fields including log content, rule description, agent name, and event data.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Search string matched against alert fields

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Number of results to return. Default: 100

name: get_alert_summary
description: Aggregate Wazuh alerts: total count, distribution by severity level, top triggered rules, and most active agents.

name: get_agents
description: List Wazuh agents registered on the manager, optionally filtered by connection status.

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Filter by status: active, disconnected, never_connected, pending. Omit for all.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Number of results to return. Default: 100
